notes.title: Another update
notes.content:
[b] New Things[/b]
-Added new cooldown bar for Generals ability.
-Added new fleet config UI.
-Changed all the main game UI.
-Added  basic Tutorial Guide on main menu.
-Added debris for destroyed corvettes.
-Added debris for destroyed destroyers.
-Added debris for destroyed siege engine.
-Added in steamworks in preparation for steam integration.
-Username now listed at the top of the main menu.
-Added new Mr Killz ability.
-Changed option menu to reflect new UI.
-Main Menu  buttons have been redesigned.

[b]Fixes[/b]
-Fixed ship cost being reduced to 0 on the shipyard.
-Fixed Cheeters ability not cooling down properly.
-Fixed Health not showing up in some cases when hovering over an object.
-Fixed some sound issues with the shield bubble.
-Fixed a bug with crew not gaining properly.
-Fixed a bug with the crew training building allowing you to put units inside it.
-Fixed a bug with research not gaining properly.
-Fixed Crew Training Facility not subtracting ore.
-Fixed Crew Training Facility not subtracting hydrogen.
-Fixed Siege Engine not spawning properly.
-Fixed a bug with wave counter not properly counting the correct wave.
-Fixed resource cost of ships not increasing with higher tier ships.
-Fixed some movement issues caused by faulty raycasting.
-Fixed missing event camera for minimap.

[b]Tweaks[/b]
-Changed the particle effect for Siege Engine a bit.
-Siege Engine can now destroy resources as well as buildings.
-Siege Engine spawns a wave of reinforcements after being brought down to a certain amount of health.
-Minimum game time has been switched to 30 minutes and the max is now 60 minutes.
-Nerfed Gunzy a tad.
-Siege Engine will now attack before reaching your portal once in range.
-Changed Gatherers to Miners in the research panel.
-Changed Def. Platform to Def. Station in research panel.
-Changed Support to H.I.S.S. in the research panel.
-Changed Laboratory to Research in the research panel.
-Changed Crew Training Facility hydrogen cost to 30 from 20.
-Increased Crew Training Facility ore cost from 10 to 20.
-Increased Crew Training Facility health from 500 to 2000.
-Added a backdrop to the wave counter.
-Deleted some unneeded duplicate objects.

notes.content:

notes.title: Heroes Update
notes.content:
[h1]HEROES! UPDATE![/h1]

Major Update to the Game We've brought more exciting features to the game with more on the way. We got a bit delayed due to Covid-19 but we're still striving to make a better and better game. We apologize for any delays. 


In this Update we add Hero Abilities each hero has their own Pros and Cons when used on the battle field. When a Hero is deployed you can activate their Ability to great effect on the field against the Swarm of technological terrors that await you. 

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Motivation Siege Engine Enemy Ship has been Added to Help you Move along during the game session ;) 
[*]Siege Engine is a unit of unstoppable might and be aware of it's ability to instantly destroy stations on contact. You must keep your bases safe and keep your forces Mobile to survive the Oncoming Onslaught.
[*]Hero Abilities for all Available Heroes.
[*]Upgradable Stations.
[*]Balanced Economy a bit more to give players more of a income boost.
[*]Custom Ship Models for Each Hero.
[*]Redesign of Fleet config Screen should be a tad more user friendly.
[*]To Use characters Active Abilities you must first Deploy them to the Field once they're Deployed on their Character Portrait you can active their ability whenever it's Available. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348979/81bb7f1eac72b69f9486bb5e50160ee761399687.jpg[/img]
[*]Mr Kills Has the ability to Unleash a powerful Rail Shot that doesn't slow down and deals massive damage in a straight path

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348979/447bb320b7364d05b270865337d1b149fdb7282f.jpg[/img]
[*]Gunzy fires a Barrage of deadly firepower onto the enemies when he unleashes his full ships power. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348979/696adb67e846194a2fdada2a9209d059889af766.jpg[/img]
[*] Mr Wuss Wuss Sucks up all the nommy resources around him to give you the edge in battle and build more ships before all is lost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348979/ca791d7b7d905aa53ec22c2551a0b91cfabeb206.jpg[/img]
[*]Cheeter active dodge Ability enabled him to just avoid damage all together when under threat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348979/af432ce7ae6bff2b27612733436f2fc22b319351.jpg[/img]
[*]Scout Deploys a Epic Shield to protect your Fellow Grimalkins In Battle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348979/3e438eb8dbf36473eec1169878fcc2c17fdc54b2.jpg[/img]
[*]Nerdy well she helps with Research Speed Bonuses to help you figure out how to best defeat the Oncoming Horrors that Await you. 
[/olist]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Fixed Issue with enemy unit not dying or being selectable properly.
[*]Fixed Issue where Units would wander off to fight a enemy at the edge of the map.
[*]Fixed Issue with unselectable Units/Buildings.
[*]Fixed Issue with enemy ships not targeting units properly.
[*]Resolved More Audio Issues in the game.
[/olist]


We're Proud of the work we accomplished and we look forward to more updates as we push Forward. Next Update is going to be Focused on UI Overhaul and more Game Tweaking to get the Formula Right. We want an exciting game and we hope to bring that to everyone here. Stay Tuned and Join our Discord for More Updates!!!!
